body: Using more capable AI starts with confidence that your data stays under your control. For Glean’s customers, privacy is a priority. Glean co-founder and CTO Vishwanath T R shares how Glean and OpenAI have worked together to help meet those needs, including through the Private Safety Processing preview. Learn more about OpenAI Private Intelligence: https://openai.com/business/private-intelligence/
ar_body: يشرح Vishwanath T R أن استخدام ذكاء اصطناعي أقدر يبدأ بالثقة بأن البيانات تحت سيطرتك، وكيف تعاونت Glean وOpenAI لتلبية ذلك عبر معاينة Private Safety Processing.
